title: DeviceConfig
description:
Complete device configuration loaded from TOML.

This is the top-level struct that contains all device protocol definitions.

**Deprecated:** New drivers should use `driver_universal::config` instead. This type is retained for compatibility with the `scripting` and `ui` crates.

binary_commands.description: Binary command definitions for protocols like Modbus RTU

default_retry.description: Default retry configuration (applies to all commands without explicit retry)

scripts.description: Rhai script definitions for complex logic that can't be expressed declaratively

ui.description: UI configuration for control panels and visualization

BinaryCommandConfig.description:
Binary command configuration for protocols like Modbus RTU.

Defines how to build a binary frame from fields with explicit types and endianness.

# Example

```toml [binary_commands.read_registers] description = "Read holding registers (Modbus function 0x03)" fields = [ { name = "address", type = "u8", value = "${device_address}" }, { name = "function", type = "u8", value = "0x03" }, { name = "start_register", type = "u16_be", value = "${start_register}" }, { name = "count", type = "u16_be", value = "${count}" }, ] crc = { algorithm = "crc16_modbus", append = true } ```

expects_response.description: Whether this command expects a response

fields.description: Ordered list of fields to build the frame

response.description: Name of the binary response definition to use for parsing

BinaryFieldConfig.description: Binary field configuration for frame building.

bytes.description: Fixed byte array value (alternative to value template)

length.description: For variable-length fields: expression for length (e.g., "${count} * 2")

value.description: Value template (can include `${param}` substitutions or hex literals like `0x03`)

BinaryFieldType.description: Binary field types with explicit endianness.

BinaryResponseConfig.description:
Binary response configuration for parsing binary frames.

# Example

```toml [binary_responses.read_registers_response] fields = [ { name = "address", type = "u8", position = 0 }, { name = "function", type = "u8", position = 1 }, { name = "byte_count", type = "u8", position = 2 }, { name = "data", type = "bytes", start = 3, length_field = "byte_count" }, ] crc = { algorithm = "crc16_modbus", validate = true } ```

BinaryResponseFieldConfig.description: Binary response field configuration for parsing.

expected.description: Expected value (for validation, hex string like "0x03")

is_error_code.description: Whether this field is the error code indicator

length_field.description: Name of another field that contains the length

position.description: Fixed position in the frame (0-based byte offset)

address_format.description: Address format (how addresses are encoded in commands)

default_address.description: Default device address on the bus

CapabilityType.description: Capability traits that a device can implement.

expects_response.description: Whether this command expects a response

response.description: Name of the response definition to use for parsing

template.description:
Command template with parameter placeholders.

Use `${param_name}` for substitution. Use `${param_name:format}` for formatted output (e.g., `${value:08X}` for hex).

timeout_ms.description: Per-command timeout override (milliseconds). If not specified, uses the connection-level timeout.

port_path.description: Optional serial port path (can be set at runtime)

ControlPanelConfig.description:
Control panel layout configuration.

Defines the sections and layout of the device control panel in the GUI.

sections.description: Ordered list of control sections to display

show_header.description: Whether to show the device header with name/status

width.description: Width hint for the panel (pixels, 0 = auto)

ControlSection.description:
A control section in the device control panel.

Uses tagged union for different section types.

oneOf.description: Motion control section with position display and jog buttons

vertical.description: Arrange buttons vertically instead of horizontally

confirm.description: Confirmation message (if set, prompts before executing)

params.description: Optional parameters to pass to the command

toggle_style.description: Show as toggle switch instead of buttons

show_color.description: Show color indicator based on wavelength

read_command.description: Command name to read the parameter value (uses `ExecuteDeviceCommand` RPC). When set, bypasses `GetParameter` and reads via the device's command manifest.

write_command.description: Command name to write the parameter value (uses `ExecuteDeviceCommand` RPC). When set, bypasses `SetParameter` and writes via the device's command manifest.

write_param.description: Parameter name in the write command template (default: "value").

ConversionConfig.description:
Unit conversion formula configuration.

Uses `evalexpr` syntax for expression evaluation.

formula.description:
Conversion formula expression.

Supports arithmetic: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%` Supports functions: `round()`, `floor()`, `ceil()`, `abs()` Supports variables from parameters.

Example: `round(degrees * pulses_per_degree)`

oneOf.description: Longitudinal Redundancy Check (XOR of all bytes)

append.description: Whether to append CRC to outgoing frames

byte_order.description: Byte order for multi-byte CRC values

validate.description: Whether to validate CRC on incoming frames

DeviceIdentity.description:
Device identity and metadata.

Defines what the device is and what capabilities it supports.

capabilities.description: List of capability traits this device implements

oneOf.description: Error - operation failed but device is OK
Critical - device may be in bad state, requires attention
Fatal - device unusable until power cycle/reset

InitStep.description: A single step in the device initialization sequence.

command.description: Name of the command to execute

required.description: Whether to fail initialization if this step fails

default.description: Default value (as JSON value for flexibility)

PresetValue.description: A preset button value with optional label.

ResponseConfig.description: Definition of a response parsing pattern.

delimiter.description: Delimiter for delimiter-based parsing (alternative to regex)

pattern.description:
Regex pattern with named capture groups.

Example: `^(?P<addr>[0-9A-Fa-f])PO(?P<pulses>[0-9A-Fa-f]{8})$`

signed.description: For hex integer types, whether to interpret as signed

RetryConfig.description:
Retry configuration for commands.

Defines how failed commands should be retried with exponential backoff.

backoff_multiplier.description: Multiplier for exponential backoff (e.g., 2.0 = double delay each retry)

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (0 = no retries)

no_retry_on_errors.description: Error codes that should NOT trigger a retry (takes precedence over retry_on_errors)

retry_on_errors.description: Error codes that should trigger a retry (if empty, retries on any error)

ScriptDefinition.description:
Rhai script definition for complex device operations.

Scripts extend the declarative config system for edge cases that can't be expressed as simple command/response patterns. Use sparingly - prefer declarative definitions when possible.

# Example

```toml [scripts.safe_move_with_correction] description = "Move with automatic overshoot correction" timeout_ms = 15000 script = """ let target = input; driver.move_abs(target); driver.wait_settled(); let actual = driver.position(); if abs(actual - target) > 1.0 { driver.move_abs(target);  // Correction move } actual """ ```

description.description: Human-readable description of what the script does

inputs.description: Names of input parameters the script expects (for documentation/validation)

returns.description: Expected return type for documentation (string, float, bool, none)

ScriptReturnType.description: Expected return type of a script.

summary_format.description: Format string for summary (uses parameter names)

summary_params.description: Parameters to show in device tree summary

TraitMappingConfig.description:
Mapping from capability trait methods to device commands.

This struct uses `#[serde(flatten)]` to capture trait method mappings, so we cannot use `deny_unknown_fields`.

TraitMethodMapping.description: Mapping for a single trait method.

command.description: Name of the command to execute (optional for polling-only or script-based methods)

from_param.description: Name of the trait method parameter (input)

input_conversion.description: Conversion to apply to input value

input_param.description: Name of the command parameter to set with converted input

output_conversion.description: Conversion to apply to output value

output_field.description: Name of the response field to extract

poll_command.description: For polling operations: command to poll

script.description:
Name of the script to execute (alternative to command for complex logic)

When set, the script is executed instead of the command. The script receives `input` as the input parameter and should return the result.

UiConfig.description:
Top-level UI configuration for a device.

Defines how the device should be displayed and controlled in the GUI.

# Example

```toml [ui] icon = "laser" color = "#FF5733"

[ui.control_panel] layout = "vertical" sections = [ { type = "motion", label = "Position", show_jog = true }, { type = "preset_buttons", label = "Presets", presets = [0.0, 45.0, 90.0] }, ] ```

color.description: Color for the device in hex format (e.g., "#FF5733")

panel_kind.description:
Explicit panel routing hint for the UI (see `common::panel_kind` constants).

When set, the UI dispatches directly to the named panel without capability heuristics. Recognized values: "pvcam", "andor_camera", "andor_shamrock", "comedi", "dover_stage", "maitai", "power_meter", "rotator", "stage", "generic".
